title: Anjali v. Rajesh Kumar
text: The petitioner-wife, Anjali, filed a petition for divorce on the ground of cruelty under Section 13 HMA. The parties were married in 2012 and have been living separately since 2017. The wife alleged mental cruelty by the husband, including repeated demands for dowry, verbal abuse, and threats of physical harm. The husband denied all allegations. The court examined oral and documentary evidence including WhatsApp messages and medical records. The pattern of conduct established amounts to mental cruelty within the meaning of Section 13 HMA. The court finds that the marriage has broken down irretrievably. Continuation of the marital relationship would cause grave injury to the petitioner. Divorce is granted under Section 13 HMA on the ground of cruelty. Permanent alimony of Rs 25,00,000 is awarded to the wife in full and final settlement. Custody of the minor child is granted to the mother with reasonable visitation rights to the father.
